description_expanded: **Must be at least 25 years of age to rent this property. 71 Magical Place at The Serenity, Dune Allen on 30a! 2 LSV's (Low Speed Vehicle), Pool, Beach * For larger groups, this home may be rented with 73 Old Winston Circle, right next door! This stunning new beach house is located in The Serenity at Dune Allen community and is situated on a prominent corner lot. The home features 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms plus a loft with a sitting area, full size daybed, full size trundle, and offers 1,946 square feet. This newly furnished home is new to the rental market and ready for your next vacation! Your vacation starts at our front door! Enjoy the spacious living area with a new sectional sofa, club chair, and HGTV. The kitchen is open to the living area and is fully stocked for all of your cooking needs. There are two barstools at the breakfast bar, and the dining area is furnished with a beautiful round farm table and seating for six. The hallway leads to the master suite, a powder room for guests, and a full size washer and dryer. The back door leads to LSV parking, an outdoor shower, outdoor seating, and sand toys! The first floor master bedroom has an ensuite bath with double vanities and a spacious tiled shower. Two guest bedrooms with king beds are located on the second floor, and there is an additional loft space suitable to be used as a fourth bedroom or an added entertainment area. There is a full bath located on the second level. Enjoy the beach at 30a at 71 Magical Place, Dune Allen Beach! CANCELLATION: Reservations that are cancelled more than 30 days prior to the arrival date receive a full refund. Reservations cancelled 14-29 days prior to arrival receive a refund of 50% of the amount paid. Reservations cancelled within 14 days of arrival receive no refund unless the guest purchased travel insurance. Guests are required to complete a rental agreement by electronic signature within 3 days of booking. NOTE: The total reservation cost includes the nightly rate, clean fee, damage waiver, processing fee and tax. By requesting a quote for this property, you agree to be added to our email subscription list.
